Yes, your 30-day evaluation cycle is stricter than Part 2.2 requires.

The standard requires evaluation "At least once every 35 calendar days" [csection-7700dd5499cead0994ec]. Your operator note explicitly states, "We evaluate patches every 30 days, not the 35 the Part allows," and confirms that "The extra strictness is deliberate" [csection-440a5cdf9a6b65292ef3]. Performing the evaluation more frequently (every 30 days) than the maximum interval allowed (every 35 days) constitutes a stricter compliance posture.
